zh: 本作所有剧情与角色均为<color=#FF0000>虚构</color>，如有雷同，实属巧合
en: All storylines and characters in this work are <color=#FF0000>fictional</color>; any resemblance to actual persons or events is purely coincidental.

zh: 本作含有<color=#FF0000>轻微暴力及紧张</color>场面，建议 12 岁以上玩家游玩
en: This work contains <color=#FF0000>mild violence and tense</color> scenes, and is recommended for players aged 12 and up.

zh: <color=#FFCC00>游戏提示：按空格或点击继续对话
en: <color=#FFCC00>Game Tip: Press Space or click to continue the dialogue</color>

zh: <color=#FF0000>我有每一小时就会失忆的失忆症！？只有23个小时了</color>
en: <color=#FF0000>I have amnesia that makes me forget every hour!? I only have 23 hours left</color>

zh: 我目前还搞不清我是谁
en: I still can’t figure out who I am

zh: 当睡意彻底散去后，如你所见，我正站在一块漂浮的岩石上面
en: After the drowsiness fully wore off, as you can see, I was standing on a floating rock

zh: 四周是一片无边无际的深渊，身边可及之处只有断裂的岩块和漂浮的尘埃
en: All around was an endless abyss, with only fractured rocks and drifting dust within reach
(What do I need to do to get out?)

zh: （在这样想着的时候，身前的岩块上不知道什么时候站着和我身形一样的人影）
en: (As I was thinking this, a figure exactly like mine was standing on the rock in front of me without my noticing)
(Who is he, and is he talking to me?)
